title: Innovation, Startups, MSMEs and Quality Manufacturing are Pillars of India's Future Growth: Mr. Piyush Goyal at 22nd J.R.D. Tata Memorial Lecture
description: The Government is strengthening India's innovation ecosystem through Research, Development and Innovation Fund, the IndiaAI Mission and the second India Semiconductor Mission, while encouraging greater investment in deep-tech startups and globally competitive manufacturing.
